bodyHtml:

Responsible Disclosure Policy

Our security-first commitment to coordinated vulnerability disclosure and safe harbor for ethical security researchers.

// 01. security-first philosophy

1. Commitment & Safe Harbor

At AJNETWORKS, security is foundational to every system we engineer. We welcome reports from independent security researchers who discover potential vulnerabilities across *.ajnetworks.co. If you conduct good-faith research in accordance with this policy, we consider your research authorized and will not initiate legal action against you.

// 02. rules of engagement

2. Guidelines for Ethical Testing

  • Avoid Service Disruption: Do not perform Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS), automated high-volume brute-forcing, or spam submissions against /api/contact.
  • Protect Data Integrity: Do not access, modify, or exfiltrate data belonging to third parties or clients. Stop testing immediately once a proof-of-concept is established.
  • No Social Engineering: Phishing or physical testing against AJNETWORKS personnel or client offices is strictly out of scope.
// 03. reporting & response sla

3. How to Submit a Vulnerability Report

Send a detailed technical report (affected URL/endpoint, reproduction steps, and impact assessment) to hello@ajnetworks.co with the subject line [SECURITY DISCLOSURE]:

  • Acknowledgment SLA: Within 24 business hours of receipt.
  • Triage & Validation: Within 3 business days.
  • Remediation Target: Critical/High findings patched within 7 days prior to coordinated public disclosure.
